limits: Built-in, not configurable: peer_stats cap 128 and CANVAS_LIMIT 30 (G-V12). A step with more than 30 camera publishers besides the probe is INVALID by construction, so an N=200 cameras-on step cannot be valid until probes report which tiles they render.
note: Every value is a proposal (doc sections 3.2, 3.3); bands come from calibration. Override per scenario with --config; fail-closed minimums are enforced at load time.

A.unit: unusable share of continuous talker audio

L.unit: p95 audio-timestamp delay, ms (absolute on synced clocks, else excess over the pair's window minimum)

Q.unit: share of tile-time with 0 < decoded video fps < 5

discard_weight.note: dimension A: each 20 ms packet NetEQ discarded (smart_flush, resync_to_live) is 20 ms of late talker audio; a bucket's discarded time counts only where it exceeds the concealment and playout silence already booked there, because discards cut the audio a stall already concealed or silenced; overrides may only raise it

playout_underrun_weight.note: dimension A: each ms the receiver's AudioWorklet played silence while the source's audio flowed (#3281) counts as 1 ms of unusable talker audio, added to concealment; an absent series is not measured, never 0; overrides may only raise it

correlated_freeze_share.note: a scrape bucket where at least this share of a receiver's camera pairs that decoded during the hold accrued freeze time is reported as froze together; never gated

correlated_freeze_min_pairs.note: a receiver with fewer camera pairs that decoded during the hold is not evaluated

target_delay_cap_ms.note: NetEQ's maximum target delay on the wasm path (RESYNC_MAX_DELAY_MS); the diagnostic reports the share of samples at it; never gated

per_talker_A_red.note: G-Q3 also fails when one unshaped talker's A, over all UxU observers, exceeds this (#2998); default 0.05; overrides may only lower it (bound [0, 0.05])

rejoin_grace_s.note: after a declared rejoin, startup time before the new session is sampled (one browser HEALTH interval + one scrape); built-in max 20

reconnect_gate_enabled.note: G-Q9 on S (red band) by p95 and k-of-n; team decision pending (#2913)

audio_delay_metric.note: per-pair audio-timestamp delay series; the client metric does not exist yet (#2948). null = gate not yet measurable

allowed_unmeasured.note: lets G-Q5 stay unmeasured only while audio_delay_metric is null; set false when #2948 lands

throttle_pod_selector.note: label matchers naming the relay and NATS pods only, for the CFS throttling diagnostic; null = not collected. Set by the runner from the target profile

health_reports_min_ratio.note: calibration pending: measure the ratio and its spread on one clean run on a dedicated metrics-api

health_reports_max_ratio.note: calibration pending: measure the ratio and its spread on one clean run on a dedicated metrics-api

rust_health_interval_s.note: #2919: session-level HEALTH every 5 s; holds once the Rust bot change (#2958) is deployed, the PR-staging bot drains every 1 s

relay_path_exemptions.note: {counter: reason}; each exemption is printed as a step notice
